resources.string: View full release notes on GitHub
After connecting the bot, the app opens Search and Videos.
Previously received videos remain visible while disconnected or reconnecting.
Fixed bot-saved audio appearing in the Extracted screen on the Conversion tab.
You can view audio downloads in the Library.
Progress, download speed, and estimated time remaining appear in the Library and system notifications.
You can stop a download from the Library or system notification.
A system notification appears when a download finishes.
Release notes are organized into lists in your selected language for easier reading.
